sa-meriones-unguiculatus.title: Gerbil (Mongolian Gerbil)
sa-meriones-unguiculatus.summary: A social, curious desert rodent that loves to dig and tunnel. Gerbils must live with at least one other gerbil, are active by day as well as at night, and produce little urine or waste.
rows: A tank or gerbilarium with a secure mesh lid: at least 100 × 40 × 40 cm (about 40 × 16 × 16 in; a 20-gallon tank is the minimum for a pair). Fill deeply with bedding for burrowing (paper, aspen, hay) and add a sand bath and chews. Wire cages and hamster cages are not suitable
Pelleted gerbil food on the bedding; small treats such as hay, unsalted pumpkin seeds and dried apple. Fresh water always
Must live in same-sex pairs or groups bought young together; adults can be aggressive to newcomers
Prefer their feet on the ground; let them come to your flat hand. Never pick up by the tail
Active by day and into the evening and night; runs, chews and digs
Grassland, shrubland, semidesert and steppe in Mongolia, China and Russia
notes: Gerbils are illegal to own in California.
